summary: Software Engineer specializing in full-stack development, high-performance visualization systems, and scalable applications. Experienced in Rust, React.js, Django, GPU rendering, and WebAssembly (WASM) for data-intensive engineering and visualization workflows.

education.school: School of Computer Science, Information, and Engineering Technology
education.degree: Master of Computing and Information Systems

education.institution: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University
education.degree: Bachelor of Technology, Computer Science and Engineering (Honors)

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Building full-stack applications using React.js, Django, REST APIs, and MySQL.
Developing GPU-optimized desktop and browser-based WebAssembly (WASM) visualization software in Rust for large-scale 2D and 3D engineering datasets.
Implementing high-performance rendering pipelines using wgpu and egui for interactive visualization of geometric, large point cloud (PCD), and mesh data.
Designing multithreaded workflows to optimize rendering and data-processing performance for large datasets.
Designing UI/UX workflows for engineering visualization and analysis tools.
Integrating and extending open-source technologies to improve visualization and system capabilities.

experience.title: Intern Software Developer
highlights: Developed Point Cloud data refinement and visualization tools for post-process monitoring in LPBF manufacturing.
Optimized SDLC and enhanced technical documentation of algorithms using JIRA.

experience.title: Graduate Research Assistant
experience.school_or_center: School of Computer Science, Information, and Engineering Technology
highlights: Researched and evaluated missing-data imputation techniques for multivariate time-series datasets.
Refined deep learning models and preprocessing workflows to improve imputation accuracy and training performance.
Implemented and tested deep learning models using PyTorch and TensorFlow.
Utilized high-performance computing (HPC) and supercomputing resources for large-scale data cleaning and model training.

experience.title: Intern Web Developer
highlights: Developed full-stack healthcare applications using Vue.js, Java Spring Boot, .NET Core, C#, REST APIs, and MySQL.
Designed responsive UI components and implemented client-side state and data-flow management for healthcare clearinghouse systems.
Built and maintained backend services and HIPAA-compliant EDI transaction workflows for EHR, EMR, and healthcare data exchange systems.

skillDefinitions.Python: A versatile programming language used for web development, data analysis, artificial intelligence, and automation. Perfect for creating websites, analyzing business data, and building smart applications.
skillDefinitions.Rust: A systems programming language focused on performance, memory safety, and concurrency. Ideal for building high-performance visualization software, WebAssembly applications, and GPU-accelerated tools.
skillDefinitions.JavaScript: A programming language that makes websites interactive and dynamic. Powers features like dropdown menus, form validation, and real-time content updates.
skillDefinitions.C#: A modern, object-oriented programming language used for building enterprise applications, web services, and desktop software on the .NET platform.
skillDefinitions.React.js: A popular library for building interactive user interfaces and websites. Creates responsive, fast-loading web applications that work great on both desktop and mobile devices.
skillDefinitions.Django REST Framework: A toolkit for building web APIs that allows different software applications to communicate with each other. Enables mobile apps and websites to share data seamlessly.
skillDefinitions.egui: An immediate-mode GUI library for Rust, used for building responsive desktop and web application interfaces with minimal boilerplate code.
skillDefinitions.wgpu: A cross-platform graphics API in Rust for GPU-accelerated rendering. Enables high-performance 2D/3D visualization in both native and WebAssembly environments.
skillDefinitions.AWS: Amazon's cloud computing platform that provides scalable web hosting, data storage, and computing power. Allows businesses to run applications without maintaining physical servers.
skillDefinitions.Git: A distributed version control system for tracking code changes, enabling collaboration, branching, and maintaining project history across development teams.
skillDefinitions.Jira: A project management and issue tracking tool used for agile software development workflows, sprint planning, and team collaboration.
skillDefinitions.HPC/Supercomputing: High-performance computing infrastructure for running large-scale computational tasks, model training, and data processing that exceeds standard computing capabilities.
skillDefinitions.REST APIs: A set of rules for how different software applications communicate over the internet. Allows mobile apps to get data from servers and enables integration between different services.
skillDefinitions.WebAssembly (WASM): A binary instruction format that enables near-native performance for web applications. Allows languages like Rust to run in the browser for compute-intensive tasks.
skillDefinitions.HTML: The foundation language for creating web pages and websites. Structures content like text, images, and links that you see when browsing the internet.
skillDefinitions.CSS: The styling language that makes websites look beautiful by controlling colors, fonts, layouts, and animations. Transforms plain web pages into visually appealing designs.
skillDefinitions.MySQL: A database system that stores and organizes information for websites and applications. Manages data like user accounts, product catalogs, and business records efficiently.
skillDefinitions.GPU Rendering: Using graphics processing units to accelerate the rendering of 2D/3D visualizations, enabling real-time interaction with large engineering datasets.
skillDefinitions.Parallel Processing: A computing approach that executes multiple tasks simultaneously to improve performance for data-intensive operations and rendering workloads.
skillDefinitions.Multithreading: A programming technique that runs multiple threads concurrently within a single process, optimizing CPU utilization for complex computational tasks.
skillDefinitions.Data Visualization: The practice of representing data graphically to reveal patterns, trends, and insights. Essential for engineering analysis and scientific communication.
skillDefinitions.2D/3D Graphics: Computer graphics techniques for rendering two-dimensional and three-dimensional visual content, used in engineering visualization and interactive applications.
skillDefinitions.English: International language of business and technology, enabling global communication and collaboration in professional environments.
skillDefinitions.Hindi: Native language proficiency enabling effective communication with Hindi-speaking clients and team members, expanding market reach in India.
skillDefinitions.Urdu: Additional language skill that enhances communication capabilities and cultural understanding in diverse professional settings.
